contradictions.why: A says it causes 'akshayam' (non-depletion/preservation) of semen, while B says it does not cause 'kshayam' (depletion). While the outcome is similar, the Sanskrit phrasing in A implies active promotion/preservation, whereas B uses a double negative construction.

contradictions.a: आर्द्राणि मत्स्यमांसानि भृष्टाश्च शफरीश्च वा । तप्ते सर्पिषि यः खादेत्
contradictions.why: A specifies 'ardrani' (fresh/raw) fish or fried small fish (shafari). B interprets 'ardrani' as 'apakvam' (uncooked/raw), which is a different culinary instruction than fresh fish.
